purpose: Teach: 追い込ま/役に立た/内定/対価/昇格/年数/クオリティ/安値

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 容疑者、追い込まれた結果、自首してまいりました。
lines.en: The suspect, cornered, has turned themselves in.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Steady delivery on the facts. No inflection waste. Professional distance maintained, but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古い防犯機器、もう役に立たないので、更新します。
lines.en: Yes. The old security equipment is no longer useful, so we'll be updating it.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Nods slightly on the opening. Clear acknowledgment without enthusiasm. Practical, straightforward delivery.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 新人警察官、内定者として、来月、配属されます。
lines.en: The new officers who have accepted their offers will be assigned next month.
lines.style: Calm procedural statement. Even pacing. Light emphasis on the timeline. Voice stays level—this is routine information.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域の安全への対価として、税金、有意義に使われていますね。
lines.en: Yes. As the price of local safety, the tax money is being used meaningfully.
lines.style: Thoughtful affirmation. Slight pause before 「有意義に」—considering the weight of the words. Warm undertone: pride in the system working.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察官の昇格、実績に基づき、公正に行われています。
lines.en: Officer promotions are carried out fairly, based on performance.
lines.style: Steady, assured. Light emphasis on 「公正に」—standing behind the integrity of the process. Professional but not defensive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。協力年数によって、警察の信頼関係、深まっています。
lines.en: Yes. Through years of cooperation, the relationship of trust with the police has deepened.
lines.style: Genuine respect in the voice. Slower pace on 「信頼関係」—letting it land. Quiet satisfaction that the partnership is solid.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 証拠品のクオリティ、保管状態、徹底しております。
lines.en: The quality and storage of evidence is maintained thoroughly.
lines.style: Precise and careful. Slight emphasis on 「徹底」—underscoring the standards held. Professional pride in the detail work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。中古品、安値で出回る場合、警察に、報告しております。
lines.en: Yes. When used items turn up on the market at low prices, we report it to the police.
lines.style: Earnest and attentive. Light pause before 「報告」—showing awareness of the responsibility. Steady, dependable tone.
